description: This file is a shell script (`nand-fwupgradecfg-gen.sh`) used for generating a configuration file for firmware upgrade in OpenWrt. It computes hash values and sizes for kernel and root filesystem files, then creates a configuration with the computed metadata.
external_files: The files specified by the arguments: $KERNEL_PATH and $ROOTFS_PATH

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script and exits.
